content:
Apple has unveiled the premiere of 《Nido de Villanas》—a comedic Mexican mini-series shot entirely on the iPhone 17 Pro, now available on YouTube as 14 Shorts.

"Four women, one inheritance, and no mercy."

Apple's YouTube channel has released a premiere trailer inviting viewers to watch the mini-series 《Nido de Villanas》, filmed entirely on the iPhone 17 Pro. The project is part of Apple's long-running "Shot on iPhone" campaign.

The trailer lays out the basic premise of 《Nido de Villanas》: "A mini-series full of ambition, secrets, and betrayal, in which four women will stop at nothing to claim the Iturribiaga family fortune."

Spanning 14 Shorts of roughly two minutes each, 《Nido de Villanas》showcases several shooting capabilities of the iPhone 17 Pro, including Action mode, 8x optical-quality zoom, slow motion, focus shifts, and more.

With its twisty plot, over-the-top acting, dramatic score and sound design, and intentionally exaggerated camera work, 《Nido de Villanas》is both a playful spoof of classic Mexican telenovelas and a stage for demonstrating the iPhone 17 Pro's imaging prowess.
